relationships.subject: SB-366791
relationships.evidence_quote: SB-366791 binds to the vanilloid site and acts as an allosteric hTRPV1 inhibitor.

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Alternatively, hTRPV1-mediated currents were induced by application of TRPV1 agonist capsaicin.

relationships.subject: SB-366791
relationships.evidence_quote: SB-366791 forms a hydrogen bond with Y511 in S3

key_findings: Cryo-EM structures of human TRPV1 in apo state and with SB-366791 show the antagonist binds the vanilloid site and closes the pore.
Mutations Y511A, L515A, L547R, T550A and E693A reduce SB-366791 inhibition.
